subject: [RFC PATCH v3 09/14] mm/memcontrol: Make memory.high tier-aware

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch makes the memory.high protection tier-aware, allowing it to enforce a fair distribution of tiered memory among workloads in isolated memory cgroups. It extends the existing memory.high protection by selectively reclaiming on tiers based on limit breaches. When memory.high is breached, it performs reclaim on all tiers. When individual tier limits are breached but memory.high is safe, it performs targeted reclaim on those tiers only. The patch only takes effect when tiered memcg limits are enabled.
